description: This C# source file defines the CachedCatalogItemServiceDecorator class, which implements the ICatalogItemService interface. It adds caching functionality to catalog item retrieval operations using local storage, with methods for listing, retrieving by ID, creating, editing, and deleting catalog items, along with internal cache refresh logic.

classes.name: CachedCatalogItemServiceDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class implementing ICatalogItemService that adds caching of catalog items using local storage, with cache expiration logic and refresh methods.

methods.name: ListPaged
methods.description: Retrieves a paged list of catalog items, using cache if valid, otherwise fetching from the underlying service.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Retrieves all catalog items, using cache if valid, otherwise fetching from the underlying service.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Gets a single catalog item by ID from the cached list.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new catalog item via the underlying service and refreshes cache.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Edits an existing catalog item via the underlying service and refreshes cache.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a catalog item by ID via the underlying service and refreshes cache.

methods.name: RefreshLocalStorageList
methods.description: Internal method to refresh the local storage cache with the latest catalog items.
